component.name: VideoButtonsGrid
component.script:
function IsValid(value as Dynamic) as Boolean return (Type(value) <> "<uninitialized>" and value <> invalid) end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press = true if key = "fastforward" or key = "rewind" dir = 0 if key = "fastforward" then dir = 1 else dir = -1 scn = invalid try: scn = m.top.getScene() : catch e: scn = invalid : end try if IsValid(scn) handled = false ' Prefer direct function if available try scn.skipFromControlBar(dir) handled = true catch e handled = false end try if handled = false ' Fallback to callFunc try: scn.callFunc("skipFromControlBar", dir) : catch e: end try end if end if return true end if end if return false end function
